category: Modern life — fields a spoken revival needs and a classical corpus lacks
label: health, illness, medicine and hygiene
note: vaidyaḥ ('a physician') and kuśalam ('well-being') are the only two atoms in this field, and kuśalam is taught as a greeting rather than as health. No word for illness, pain, medicine or a hospital. Counted covered, very thinly, and the four proxy points behind it are effectively open.
